author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에 드물게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 주로 소나무 숲에서 무리를 지어 겨울을 난다. 밤에 활동하며 들쥐, 작은 들새, 곤충을 먹는다. 번식할 때는 잡목 숲 속에 있는 매나 말똥가리 등의 헌 둥지에 알을 4~6개 낳고, 암컷이 품는 동안 수컷이 먹이를 가져다준다. 유럽, 시베리아 남부, 내몽골, 중국 북동부, 일본 등 구북구의 한대·온대에 분포하며, 겨울에는 중국 남부, 인도 북부, 이란 등지로 내려간다.

art.subject: Long-eared Owl (Asio otus), adult (sexes similar), as seen roosting in Korean pine groves in winter: long dark ear tufts edged buff, rising from the top of the head; facial disc orange-buff with a dark rim, dark vertical marks through the eyes and whitish eyebrows meeting between them; upperparts tawny-buff mottled and vermiculated dark brown and grey; underparts buff, the breast with bold dark streaks and the lower breast and belly with streaks crossed by fine bars. Bill blackish; eyes deep orange; legs and toes feathered buff.
art.pose: roosting upright in a pine, ear tufts raised
art.scene: Korean pine grove in winter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, front view perched: long ear tufts, orange-buff facial disc with dark marks through the deep-orange eyes, lower belly with bold streaks crossed by fine bars
adult, side view perched upright: slim body, raised ear tufts, tawny-buff upperparts mottled dark brown
art.build: Medium-sized, slender owl, about 38cm, a little larger than a feral pigeon, with a narrow body and long ear tufts. At roost it often stands very upright and thin, tufts raised, close to the trunk. Bill short and hooked. Wings long; in flight orange-buff patches at the base of the primaries, a dark carpal patch and finely barred wingtips.
avoid: Do not paint yellow eyes in black surrounds; that is Short-eared Owl (Asio flammeus). Long-eared Owl has deep orange eyes.
Do not paint short or absent ear tufts.
Do not paint it huge and heavy like Eurasian Eagle-Owl (Bubo bubo); it is slim and pigeon-sized.
Do not paint plain unbarred streaks on the belly; the streaks are crossed by fine bars.
